about: A pickaxe: a two-ended iron head, a long pick and a shorter one, on a long haft. The tool that breaks rock and ore (the stone and iron pickaxes).

hold_class.source: tools/characters/attach_kinds.json (hafted's classes; holding.md: tools keep their own class)

hands.source: D567: two-handed, as a real pickaxe of 0.9 m is swung

open.why: today it is held and swung in the main hand alone, as every tool: its two-handed takes and the off hand's IK onto the second grip are not built

lead.source: D463: the main hand, the left on a left-handed body; if two-handed, the main hand still leads (holding.md's lead, Main unless a bow)

grip_type.source: D562: in hand, a power grip closed by touch on the haft

slots.name: head
slots.joins: its eye's two openings on the haft's line; the haft made to their diameters, 4 mm proud of eye.upper

slots.name: haft
slots.joins: a round shaft along +Y from its butt; it may flare under the head, as real ones do, read at each join's own place

slots.name: binding
slots.joins: its bore on the haft, its top against the head's eye.lower

slots.name: butt
slots.joins: its bore over the haft's -Y end

grip.how: on the haft, grip_from_end up from its butt (the reference's 0.08 m; D546's hafted 0.04 to 0.12): the item's origin

second.how: a point on the haft a fixed distance from the grip (toward the head), part of the reference item, not of the envelope (research/2026-10-28-assembled-items-animation.md section 3); two-handed by D567

open.why: its distance is set with the pick's two-handed takes, keyed with both hands; none exist

edge.how: the head's longer pick's tip point (its point, on -Z, D546: the longer pick toward -Z) carried through; the shorter end is not a working edge

held.how: a tool has no ready pose: the Tool stance holds no guard (holding.md), so in hand it is carried until used

used.how: a blow plays the walker's Sword_Attack and a use its Interact (terra_walker::figure); items.ron's tool.cuts and strikes say what it breaks

open.why: a pick's own swing, keyed for the reference so its point leads, keyed with both hands (D567)

carried.how: tipped by the carry rule, its head forward and down, no lower than 0.55 m under the grip (attachment.md Carried)

stowed.how: two-handed, so across the back (D567, D551's two-handed row), beside a shield there

open.why: the turn and offset on the socket are not set (attachment.md Stowed's next step); a 0.9 m pick across the back must clear the head

blocking.how: a tool does not block: the Tool stance's off button is the build menu (holding.md)

animation.how: none yet of its own: the Tool stance plays the walker's use and strike clips

open.why: a pick's use set (holding.md's count, the tools' three), keyed for the reference

length_m.source: art/held/iron_pickaxe.json length; the look's bounds measured 0.900

mass_kg.source: the head and a 0.04 m ash haft 0.9 m long (670 kg/m^3, recalled), 0.76 kg; a stand-in until its parts are weighed

balance_m.source: computed from the head at 0.86 m and the haft's middle, from the grip

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's I = m (b^2 + L^2/12) on the numbers above

grip_diameter_m.source: art/held/iron_pickaxe.json haft (0.04: the source's 8.3 cm handle thinned to a real pick's)

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's tempo clamp 0.85 to 1.15: I_ref/1.15^2 to I_ref/0.85^2

length_m.source: the reference's length ±10% at a fixed head (research/2026-10-28-assembled-items-animation.md section 1)

head_mass_kg.source: the inertia band at the reference's length, solved for the head (-28% to +44%)

balance_m.source: the inertia band at the reference's mass and length, solved for the balance

envelope.state: computed from stand-in masses; no pick clips keyed for any item, so nothing measured
